content_sections.heading: About NHSRC
content_sections.text: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is based in New Delhi. NHSRC issued this Terms of Reference on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. The post supports CTD in the planning of the NTEP programme and in coordination with donors and States.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: MBA in Healthcare Management / Master's Degree in Public Health (MPH) / PGD in Healthcare Management. Working knowledge of computers. The following are preferred. The notice does not list them as essential requirements. At least five years of experience working with public health programs. Skills in program planning, budgeting, donor relationships, proposal development and project management are an added plus. Knowledge of tuberculosis control is advantageous. The age limit is "Upto 65 years". Candidates must also be ready to travel extensively. The notice does not print an "as on" date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Technical Officer (Planning and Donor Coordination) post.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Technical Officer (Planning and Donor Coordination) will have these responsibilities: Provide technical support to CTD in the development and revision of the NTEP program implementation plan. Assist CTD in the development of proposals for bilateral donor agencies. Facilitate CTD interactions with Donors, including Donor reporting, joint Donor missions, Mid-term review, etc. Assist CTD in building the capacity of States in planning and budgeting. Assist CTD in reviewing and advising on budgeted annual action plans from State/UTs, within the context of overall State NHM PIPs. Assist CTD in coordinating with States for PIP/donor related issues, reviews, reporting, etc. Work in collaboration with technical officers of other thematic areas of the program on cross cutting issues. Facilitate change management with respect to the use of ICT and Nikshay tools for data entry, validation and their use for public health action. Any other job assigned as per program need.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHSRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the NHSRC website, http://nhsrcindia.org . Fill in the online application for the Technical Officer (Planning and Donor Coordination) post correctly. Submit the application in the prescribed online application format. Applications in any other format will not be accepted. Make sure the application is received by 30 November 2026, the last date for receiving applications. The notice does not list the documents to upload, and it does not mention an application fee.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The post is offered purely on a contractual basis. If the recruitment process includes a written test, the minimum qualifying mark will be 70%. Candidates must be ready to travel extensively.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications for the Technical Officer (Planning and Donor Coordination) post is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for the NHSRC Technical Officer (Planning and Donor Coordination) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBA in Healthcare Management, a Master's Degree in Public Health (MPH) or a PGD in Healthcare Management, along with working knowledge of computers.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the NHSRC Technical Officer post?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 65 years. Candidates must also be ready to travel extensively.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the NHSRC Technical Officer (Planning and Donor Coordination)?
faq.answer: The remuneration range is between Rs. 90,000/- and Rs. 1,30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the online application on the NHSRC website (http://nhsrcindia.org). Applications are accepted in the prescribed online application format only.

faq.question: Q6. Is the NHSRC Technical Officer post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The Terms of Reference say the post is filled purely on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q7. Is experience mandatory for the NHSRC Technical Officer post?
faq.answer: Experience is listed as a preferential qualification, not an essential one: at least five years of experience working with public health programs. Knowledge of tuberculosis control is also listed as advantageous.

faq.question: Q8. What are the qualifying marks if NHSRC holds a written test?
faq.answer: If the recruitment process includes a written test, the minimum qualifying mark will be 70%.
